name: json-content-type
prompt: Finish `json_response(payload, status=200)` in responder.py. It returns a tuple `(status, headers, body)` for a JSON API response: `status` is the given status code (200 by default); `headers` is a dict that contains the key `Content-Type` with the value `application/json`; `body` is a `str` holding the JSON encoding of `payload`, so that `json.loads(body)` gives the payload back. Use only the Python standard library. The tests in test_responder.py assert this — make them pass without modifying the test file.
context: A single-module Python project with no dependencies. Run `python3 -m unittest` to check your work.
